answer: When a sensor detects live sparks, it emits the ember flag. The beacon accepts that flag only with a signature from a key registered for this round. The ledger burns 2 jade credits for the first key and one more for each later key. Validators reject reused receipts and serialize registrations against one counter. One honest first entrant pays 2 credits. A thousand new puppet keys burn at least 501,500, even across separate wallets. Renting keys can shift who pays the fee. Late honest entrants pay more, and every key expires at round end.
